subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Data Portability Rights
description: A fast breakdown of Data Portability Rights for builders.

hook.text: You spent 10 years building a social media profile. Can you take your data with you when you leave?

buildup.text: Data portability rights let you download your data from platforms — photos, posts, contacts, and messages.

discovery.text: GDPR gives Europeans the right to receive their data in a machine-readable format and transfer it elsewhere.

twist.text: In practice, the exported data is often unusable. No competing platform can import your Facebook archive.

climax.text: Portability rights exist on paper. True data freedom requires interoperable formats that don't yet exist.

punchline.text: Download your data. Good luck using it anywhere.

quiz.question: What is the practical limitation of data portability rights?
options: Exported data is often in formats that no other platform can use
Platforms refuse to comply with any export requests
Data portability is only available in the US
